serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Tansi is a cloud-based operational ERP and operations execution platform that works alongside an organization's existing ERP to manage field execution, workforce readiness, asset operations, and compliance in one configurable system. The platform supports workforce management and onboarding, learning management and certification tracking, mobile forms and approval workflows with offline data capture, asset, inventory, and maintenance tracking, contractor compliance, incident reporting and corrective actions, and operational communications and reporting. The platform is hosted on Microsoft Azure and is made available to customers through web and mobile applications.

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: Trust Center containing all the necessary documentation for FedRAMP Certification submission package.
trustCenter.accessRequestInstructions: Access requests can be submitted by pressing the 'Request FedRAMP access' button on the top right of the Trust Center.

secureConfigurationGuidance.accessRequestInstructions: Access requests can be submitted by pressing the 'Request FedRAMP access' button on the top right of the Trust Center.

overallSummaryOfAssessment: GreenHat Assurance LLC (Kalispell, Montana; Firm License No. PAC-FIRM-LIC-58382) performed a SOC 2 Type II examination of the Tansi system for the period November 3, 2025 to April 3, 2026, covering the Security, Availability, Confidentiality, and Privacy Trust Services Criteria. The examination resulted in an unqualified opinion with no exceptions noted; one control (confidential data deletion upon request) was not tested due to no requests occurring during the period. Microsoft Azure, SendGrid, and Twilio were presented as subservice organizations under the carve-out method. Independent verification and validation of Tansi's security controls (per FRC-CLA-MFR/IVV-CSX-AIA) is satisfied through Tansi's annual SOC 2 Type II examination.
